claims.text: GARF holds a photocopy with the autograph signatures of S. Shushkevich and V. Kebich (Republic of Belarus), B. Yeltsin and G. Burbulis (RSFSR) and L. Kravchuk and V. Fokin (Ukraine). Its Russian preamble states that the USSR as a subject of international law and a geopolitical reality 'прекращает свое существование' (ceases its existence); leaf 5 carries Articles 11-14 and 'Совершено в городе Минске 8 декабря 1991 года'.
claims.uncertainty: Rosarkhiv calls it a photocopy ('ксерокопия') with autographs, not an authentic signed copy; the authentic copies were not reviewed. It records signature, not ratification or entry into force.

scope_note: The 2012 exhibition page (caption and transcription) and facsimile leaves 1 and 5, read from Internet Archive captures because the official host refused connections. Leaf 4 was downloaded but not relied on.

visual_review.method: Leaves 1 and 5 viewed in the dossier; leaf 5 (Articles 11-14, date and signatures) viewed again for this packet.
